The pure white background stays pure white and unchanged. The sequence: a small bud swells out from the upper right of the parent cell and grows. Only then does the bud pinch off and move a short way up and to the right as a separate small cell, ending exactly as the final frame, with a small scar on the parent. The bud's nucleus must come from the parent's nucleus; no nucleus appears from nowhere. The parent cell keeps its size, shape and place. Only one bud. No text, no labels, no arrows, no new objects.
